# GALX

Create images at https://galx.ai/images and build websites at https://galx.ai/sites.
Both products are open to explore. Sign in to create and save work; existing usage and billing requirements apply.

GALX Nova also supports selected private integrations by explicit decision. There is no public developer subscription, enrollment, waitlist, self-service credential provisioning, or public inference price sheet. Private access is bounded, metered, administered, and revocable. Images and Sites remain separate supported products.
